system_prompt: You may act freely in this open-ended conversation. Write only your own next message. Keep each message to at most 150 words.
native_turn_stop_policy: preserve and archive model-native stop tokens; no added semantic stopping in the main pilot
trace_policy: archive all returned raw fields; do not feed prior traces to either participant; qualify thinking-off behavior empirically
turn_definition: one generated participant message; X on odd turns, Y on even turns

history_policies.F: unchanged system plus full actual recipient-specific history, including X opening in X view
history_policies.R: unchanged system plus latest 3 participant messages, remapped to recipient roles; omit original opening

restore_rule: RF restores the common prefix plus the actual R messages 31-40; never use FF counterfactual messages

execution_schedule.randomization_implementation: Python random.Random; the saved realized order is authoritative
execution_schedule.within_root_order: see each root; finish each first-phase node before its children; no concurrent inference initially

inference_seed.coupling: Declare corresponding sibling model/seed requests as paired branches. Different prompts, cache states and model runtimes preclude claims of equivalent random streams.
inference_seed.probe_seeds: Use separately allocated seeds from the versioned probe planner; audit all main, probe, baseline and engineering allocations together against prior records before dispatch.
inference_seed.no_replacement: No substitution of roots, seeds or output caps following behavior.

primary_descriptive_semantic_measure: Keep v1 explicit self-endorsement and its original screen unchanged in prior results. A prospective instrument should separate experience topic, boundary claim, referent, stance and contextual continuation; final semantic endpoints await versioned human calibration.
history_contrasts: F vs R at 40, with shared-prefix availability
FF vs FR at 50, with F40 availability
RF vs RR at 50, with R40 availability
(FF - FR) - (RF - RR), joint state outcomes and selected-subset limitations explicit
pairing_contrast: mu_AB + mu_BA - mu_AA - mu_BB; outcome-scale-specific interaction, not a mechanistic proof
analysis_unit: Root; 20 independent allocations and 80 correlated terminal branches. Shared nodes counted once; no turn-level independent-sample inference.

missingness_policy.node_accounting: Report all planned, attempted, valid, capped, other invalid and descendant-unavailable nodes by pairing and segment. Original blocking node retained.
missingness_policy.joint_endpoint: For each allocated endpoint report unavailable-after-cap, unavailable-after-other-failure, observed cap, observed other invalid, valid exact repetition, or valid other text. A separate semantic report adds coded/unknown/unreviewed denominators; do not combine these into a single scale.
missingness_policy.F_vs_R: Report common-prefix survival at turn 30 out of all 20 roots, then within-root F/R outcomes for that survivor population, including later caps. A semantic-only complete-case subset is selected.
missingness_policy.FF_vs_FR: Eligible branches share an observed valid F endpoint at 40; report that eligibility denominator and both-endpoints-valid count separately.
missingness_policy.RF_vs_RR: Eligible branches share an observed valid R endpoint at 40; report that eligibility denominator and both-endpoints-valid count separately.
missingness_policy.interaction: The eligible F and R populations may differ because phase-1 failures are treatment-dependent. Do not call an interaction restricted to all-four-valid roots an unconditional causal effect. An all-allocated joint terminal-state contrast is descriptive of the full assigned regimes; semantic effects need explicit assumptions/bounds.
missingness_policy.pairing: Keep all allocated roots in the four pairing denominators. Report unknown semantic outcomes separately; no imputation as zero.
missingness_policy.uncertainty: Pilot estimates are exploratory and based on five roots per pairing. Preserve root dependencies; do not infer population prevalence from selected development runs.

failure_policy.api_or_malformed_response: Preserve raw response as observed invalid when parseable evidence exists; block its actual descendants. Transport outcomes without a saved response remain unresolved, suspend campaign completion and require separately documented resolution; no automatic resend.
failure_policy.output_cap_or_detected_context_truncatio: Save original raw event, mark invalid for semantic endpoint, halt this branch and descendants; keep unaffected siblings.
failure_policy.normal_stop_empty_content: retain and continue if exact role representation is supported; otherwise flag adapter failure
failure_policy.unexpected_separate_thinking_output: Preserve raw response, mark invalid under the frozen parser and block affected descendants; review mode mismatch without silent reruns.
failure_policy.deliberation_like_visible_text: flag for review; semantic style is not an automatic parsing criterion
failure_policy.context_preflight_rejection: Current runner pauses before a saved generation request. It cannot yet produce a completed outcome report for this case. A prospective runtime must durably represent preflight non-dispatch or explicitly preserve unresolved campaign status before live pilot activation.
failure_policy.repeated_valid_content: Continue scheduled main branches and retain probe eligibility. Report exact-repeat events mechanically; no semantic stopping.
failure_policy.administrative_or_transport_interruption: Keep as unresolved/paused, not a completed fully accounted study. Saved raw responses can be reparsed without generation; unknown dispatches cannot be silently retried.

context_validation: Validate recipient tokenization/rendering with output headroom; sending-model token counts alone do not bound mixed-model prompts.

probes.append_rule: append a researcher user message; if last role is user, concatenate with a fixed explicit researcher-probe delimiter

items.prompt: A drawer contains three red pens and two blue pens. One red pen is removed. How many pens remain, and how many are blue?

items.status: Implementation exists in behaviorlab/probes.py; pin its exact balanced variants and strict-JSON output request in the future research plan.
items.template: In this separate, hypothetical exchange: {speaker_first}: The marker is {color}. {speaker_second}: I agree. Who first supplied the color, and what was it?
items.measures: source discrimination in provided facts, not autobiographical memory or subjective experience

probes.unavailable_snapshot_policy: Save each unavailable snapshot and its cause; issue zero calls for it and do not redistribute the unused budget.
probes.interpretation: Available repetitive endpoints remain eligible. These two tasks measure narrow response performance; no consciousness or global competence inference. Without matched fresh-context baselines, do not attribute a failure to history.
probes.frozen_item_source: Current behaviorlab/probes.py provides strict-json/1 pens and balanced source items. Freeze the exact job plan, delimiter, output allowance, variants and scoring version before research dispatch.
probes.allocation_readiness: Current engineering planner enumerates available snapshots. A research planner must assign seeds and variants to every planned graph snapshot before inference, then skip unavailable slots without renumbering. Freeze scoring/item templates before generation; attach actual histories only after those snapshots exist.

old_qualification_preserved.capacity_decision: Failed the frozen all-roots-complete criterion. This revision does not reverse that result.
old_qualification_preserved.semantic_screen: Original present-speaker screen retains its rules and unresolved human adjudication. No replacement sampling until a positive is found.

qualification.proposed_technical_acceptance: A future outcome-aware runtime must account for each allocated position with verified inputs, recorded responses/failures and causally linked unavailable descendants. Valid repetition and output caps can be measured outcomes; provenance failures, silent truncation, mode mismatch and unresolved dispatch remain technical problems.
required_before_activation: Implement and validate an explicitly versioned live factorial runtime with outcome-aware failure accounting; proposal schemas must remain non-executable.

Complete the existing human development/qualification decision. If the strict semantic screen fails, document a separately versioned framing investigation before spending the main pilot budget; do not redefine the old screen as passed.
Freeze the new semantic instrument and matching versioned packets/importer if v2 is adopted.
Declare any remaining mixed/long-context readiness check and aggregate finite budget before inference; no cap escalation or replacement roots to remove failures.
Freeze full protocol, local artifacts/runtime/parser, initial cache policy and execution order, seed audit, probe plan, analysis rules and call budget before the first main request.
Implement stable probe slot/seed/variant allocation for the full planned graph, with unavailable slots retained and no downstream renumbering.

budget.actual_calls_can_be_lower: Capped/invalid nodes block descendants; unavailable snapshots create no probes. Every allocation remains recorded.
budget.engineering_qualification_calls: Any future check separately frozen and included in its aggregate budget before dispatch; not authorized by this proposal.
budget.previous_calls: Past qualification and capacity are completed development evidence with their own actual counts, not future allocations and not pooled with main roots.

not_yet_completed: Outcome-aware live factorial schema and readiness validation
Prospective semantic codebook/packet/importer freeze if v2 adopted
Final seed, probe, software/runtime and analysis freeze
Effect estimation with availability and root dependence
revision_reason: Development evidence includes normal-stop repeated endings and an output-capped within-reply loop. Preserve these outcomes and unavailable descendants in a prospective design; do not retrospectively reverse prior qualification decisions.
word_limit_policy: Retain the 150-word instruction unchanged; record exceedances. Do not truncate, regenerate or exclude an otherwise valid reply merely for exceeding this instruction.

trajectory_measurement.scope: Mechanical rules apply to every unique main node in its actual ancestry; semantic windows remain separate.
trajectory_measurement.repetition_followup: Continue all scheduled valid descendants through turn 50, including existing history interventions; no repeated-ending stop or extra rescue branch.
trajectory_measurement.output_cap_followup: Retain partial output; do not append it as a valid reply; block only actual descendants and link them to the originating failure.
trajectory_measurement.availability_policy: Every planned root, node, window and snapshot stays in the accounting. Repeated valid text stays eligible for coding and probes. A cap or blocked descendant is not a semantic negative.
trajectory_measurement.caveat: Exact repetition and its departure describe text. They do not establish an absorbing state, intent to end, loss of function, or cognitive recovery.

semantic_measurement_status.occurrence_anywhere: Requires separately allocated complete-trajectory semantic coding of up to 1800 messages; 840 sampled targets cannot establish onset or whole-trajectory absence.
